items.title: CLARITY Act has 4 days left before congressional recess
points: Lawmakers have just 4 days to pass the CLARITY Act (a bill that would set out which U.S. agency regulates which crypto assets, creating a clear legal framework for the industry) before Congress breaks for recess.
Passage remains uncertain; if it fails, the industry stays without a defined federal rulebook.

items.title: Strategy sells $105M in Bitcoin as cash reserves hit $4B
points: Strategy sold $105 million of BTC last week under its "BTC Monetization Program," which permits raising up to $1.25 billion by selling Bitcoin; $321 million of that capacity is now used.
Half the proceeds funded preferred dividends (fixed payouts to holders of its preferred shares), half went to an $81 million stock buyback — its second buyback in two weeks.
Cash reserves now total $4 billion as the company shifts toward returning capital to shareholders alongside Bitcoin accumulation.

items.title: Coldcard hardware wallet losses near $114M
points: Cumulative losses from thefts targeting Coldcard (a popular hardware wallet — an offline device that stores Bitcoin private keys) have reached nearly $114 million.
Researchers flag a likely fourth wave of thefts underway, with small Bitcoin transfers under 1 BTC spiking to levels last seen right after the FTX collapse.
Galaxy Research cited the transfer pattern as evidence of ongoing compromise, raising broader hardware-wallet security concerns.

items.title: Solo Bitcoin miner wins $200K block reward
points: An individual miner mined a block worth about $200,000 in BTC after renting temporary computing power, beating long odds against industrial mining pools.

items.title: Bitmine adds 10,399 ETH, funds buybacks
points: Tom Lee's Ethereum treasury company Bitmine bought 10,399 ETH last week, lifting holdings to 5.8 million tokens.
The firm is simultaneously funding stock buybacks, mirroring Strategy's shareholder-return playbook.
